question: Does an audiobook count as reading?
scope: Listening to an unabridged book. Compare ordinary reading uses and specific skills without ranking accessibility, reading formats, or readers.

turns.text: Audiobooks count as reading. You learn the story and hear the author's words.

claims.hint: Name another way to learn a book’s story.
Name another way to hear a writer’s words.

turns.text: Reading means looking at words. Listening to a voice is different.

claims.hint: Name a way to read without sight.

rejected.reason: That still uses visible print. Name another reading method.

claims.hint: Name a way to read by hearing a voice.

turns.text: If it reads all the words aloud, it counts as reading. Even a computer voice counts.

claims.hint: Name spoken words you would call listening, not reading.
Name another use for a computer voice.

turns.text: When reading, you go at your own speed and go back. Audio just keeps playing.

claims.hint: Name an audio tool that lets you change the speed.

rejected.reason: That is a print tool. Name an audio device or control.

claims.hint: Name an audio tool that takes you back.

turns.text: Listening counts as reading if you listen closely and understand it.

claims.hint: Name something else you listen to closely.
Name another way to understand a message.

turns.text: A narrator adds acting. That changes the book, so listening is different from reading.

claims.hint: Name a kind of reading that also adds acting.
Name a book performance that keeps all the words.
